items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and continue the existing report-only finance reconciliation. Do not approve new spend, monetization expansion, forecasts, ROI, payback, contribution-margin claims, or queue work. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The 18 named tracking rows show $0 site-attributed commission, while the $4.92 aggregate row cannot be assigned to a site without inventing attribution. AI usage cost is $928.5425623 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 across 5,097 calls and 39 instrumented sites; this period does not match the one-day revenue window. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, AI payback, infrastructure spend, labor cost, commitments, budget exposure, and forecasts are unknown—not zero. Clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, ordered items, shipped items, and operational outcomes are prioritization signals, not financial performance.

Minimum finance artifact: reconcile the 18 named provider tracking rows and aggregate row for 2026-09-21 against matching-period site/content revenue, ordered and shipped items, commission, AI cost, infrastructure cost, labor and other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and an approved cost-to-learn threshold. Preserve unavailable values as unknown; do not extrapolate the one-day commission or the 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 AI cost into monthly revenue, margin, payback, or budget forecasts.
